title: Đề Dự Đoán 14 — Living Home Club

provenance.path: APTIS/Writing/Bộ đề dự đoán/Living Home Club.docx

parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
parts.prompt:
When you're little, how do you feel when you have to share a room with your siblings?
I was really delighted when I had to share a room with my sister. My bedroom was big and beautiful. I was scared of the dark and ghosts. Therefore,I could sleep well if there was someone sleeping with me.

parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: Question 1: Describe the room where you are living?
My room is quite small/spacious. I am an aesthetically-inclined person, so I constantly decorated my room to make it more pleasant. My room is equipped with many colorful lights.
Question 2: Which place do you want to live in: countryside or city? Why?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
" Nowadays many youngsters want to have a house or an apartment early in their life, do you have any advice for them? Why?”
Email 1 : Email to your friend
Dear Bobby,
How are things?
Do you know that there are more and more young people who want to have a house or an apartment as soon as possible?
I think it is a good way for them to live independently.
What do you think bro?
Love
Anna
Email 2 : Email to the club manager
Dear Sir or Madam,
My name is Anna. I have been a club’s member for three months. I am writing this email to respond to your last email about the club’s issue.
According to the news, nowadays there are more and more young people who want to live in a house or an apartment on their own as soon as possible.
In my opinion, it is a good way for them to live independently. They will have to earn money to pay for the fee of daily life, for example food, drinks, furniture and so on. In addition, they should learn how to use time and money effectively. Moreover, they should consider their budget before deciding because a new apartment might make them stuck in debt.
I am looking forward to hearing from you if my ideas are acceptable.
Best regards,
Anna

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your friend who is also a member of Living Home Club. Express your thoughts and feelings about the announcement and suggest what you both should do.
Write an email to the president/manager of Living Home Club. Give your detailed feedback, propose constructive solutions for the initiative, and explain why your suggestions would benefit the club.
